claire_radar.whyItMatters: Deep research systems are typically evaluated on report generation, but enterprise tasks often require actionable workflows. DRFLOW addresses this gap by assessing workflow prediction, offering metrics for factual grounding, step recovery, and personalization, which can guide development of more practical agents.
